ledger.claim: A cancellation fee is chargeable only if the driver carries all four limbs of POL-NS-01: a recorded 'arrived' event; a gps_trace placing him inside the POL-NS-02 geofence at or before that event; a continuous in-geofence hold of at least the zone minimum, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the 'arrived' tap; and a driver-side termination on a recognised reason code at or after the dwell elapsed. The rider's position is that each limb must be established on this trip's own admissible evidence, and that the failure of any single limb takes the fee out of POL-NS-01 altogether and sends the outcome to POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05 or POL-NS-06 as applicable.

The charge does not turn on where the rider was. POL-NS-01 tests only the driver's arrival, in-geofence position, dwell and termination; rider position appears nowhere in it, and POL-NS-06 makes the shortfall refund payable 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages'. The rider's device sat at 519.47 m from the pin for the whole waiting window, outside the 200 m AIRPORT presence radius, and that fact goes only to POL-NS-04(c) - it cannot be used to make out the charge against the rider.

The rider does not contest proximity and does not press POL-NS-05. On the driver's own trace all 51 in-geofence fixes fall inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius (derived mean distance from the pin 24.011 m), and the qualifying run begins at 22:40:00, before the 22:40:20 'arrived' event, so POL-NS-02 is satisfied and POL-NS-01 limb (b) is met. At the arrival timestamp the trace shows the driver stationary at 0.0 km/h well within 300 m of the pin, so the marker is not false under POL-NS-05 and there is no recomputation of the waiting clock.

The rider likewise does not press POL-NS-06. The minimum dwell for the AIRPORT zone class is 480 seconds, and the longest continuous in-geofence run measures 500 seconds, from the first qualifying fix at 22:40:00 to the cancellation at 22:48:20 - a surplus of 20 seconds (the derived shortfall is -20.0 seconds). There is therefore no shortfall to refund under POL-NS-06 and no limb (i) accumulation question is reached.

POL-NS-04 does not apply on this record. The rider sent one message, at 22:41:40 ('I am walking over now'), and the driver replied at 22:41:58, eighteen seconds later, so limb (b) fails and the clause is displaced 'regardless of the content of the reply'. Limb (c) fails as well: the rider track places the device at 519.47 m from the pin, outside the 200 m AIRPORT presence radius, with zero qualifying fixes. The rider's explanation that Changi T3 is large and the walk to the bay is long is a point about the terminal's internal geography; the record carries no venue geometry for that walk, and the rider does not rest the point on general knowledge of the airport's layout.

No traffic advisory is available on this record, and the rider discloses that plainly: EV-ADVIS-09102-01 is MISSING, carries weight 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT is recorded against it. The driver therefore cannot rely on POL-NS-06(i) to sum separate in-geofence intervals, and in any event the trace shows a single in-geofence interval. The rider cites the absent advisory only to close that route off and builds no part of this case on it.

The driver arrived inside the pickup geofence. His own GPS trace carries 51 fixes and the maximum distance from the pickup pin across the whole trace is 24.0 m, so every fix falls inside the 150 m arrival radius the fee schedule sets for the AIRPORT zone class. POL-NS-02's requirement of at least three consecutive in-radius fixes is satisfied many times over, and the trip record independently carries the driver 'arrived' event at 22:40:20.

The dwell requirement is met. The longest continuous qualifying in-geofence run is 500 seconds, running from 22:40:00 to 22:48:20, against the 480-second minimum dwell for the AIRPORT zone class - a margin of 20 seconds. Under POL-NS-01 limb (c) that clock runs from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and not from the 'arrived' tap, and it still clears the minimum.

All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold on this record. Limb (a): the trip record contains a driver 'arrived' event at 22:40:20. Limb (b): the trace places the driver 24.0 m from the pin at and before that timestamp, inside the arrival radius. Limb (c): 500 seconds of continuous in-geofence dwell against a 480-second minimum. Limb (d): the record shows no boarding event and the trip terminated by the driver at 22:48:20 - 20 seconds after the required dwell elapsed - with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises.

The arrival marker is not a false arrival marker under POL-NS-05. Matched to the 22:40:20 'arrived' event, the trace places the driver 24.0 m from the pickup pin, far inside the 300 m threshold, and the only speed recorded across the entire trace is 0.0 km/h, below the 15 km/h motion threshold. There is therefore no recomputation of the waiting clock and no false-arrival finding against the driver.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, because limb (b) fails outright. The rider wrote 'I am walking over now.' at 22:41:40 and the driver answered 'Okay, I will remain at Door 5.' at 22:41:58 - 18 seconds later, well within the 120-second reply window, and the driver placed no in-app call but had no need to. Where the driver replied inside 120 seconds the clause does not apply at all, whatever the reply said.

POL-NS-04 limb (c) is also affirmatively failed on admissible fixes, so the rider-exonerating route is doubly closed. The rider's own track places the rider's device 519.5 m from the pickup pin on its 24 fixes, and rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0 - no fix at all falls inside the 200 m AIRPORT rider-presence radius, let alone a majority of qualifying fixes across the waiting window.

There is no waiting-period shortfall under POL-NS-06. The effective in-geofence dwell is 500 seconds against the 480-second AIRPORT minimum; the trace reports a shortfall of -20 seconds, meaning the minimum is met, so the cancellation fee is chargeable and no full refund follows. The driver does not assert limb (i) accumulation at all: the trace shows a single in-geofence interval with no excursions, and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09102-01 is MISSING with admissibility weight 0.0 and no payload - it carries no fact and is named here only to record that no accumulation against it is claimed.

The driver is owed compensation on the verified no-show. POL-NS-01 being satisfied and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 sets compensation at 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee, that is SGD 4.80. No POL-GEN-02 discount applies to the driver's case. ruling.explanation:
Both parties have, in the end, done the same arithmetic, and the record supports it. This is a rider-filed dispute over the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee charged on TRP-09102, and the question is whether the driver earned it under POL-NS-01.

All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold on this trip's own admissible evidence. (a) The trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 22:40:20. (b) The GPS trace places the driver 24.0 m from the pickup pin (derived driver_track.max_distance_m 24.01 m over 51 qualifying fixes) at and before that timestamp, well inside the 150 m arrival radius the fee schedule sets for the AIRPORT zone class, and the qualifying run starts at 22:40:00, before the 'arrived' tap. (c) The continuous in-geofence dwell runs from the first qualifying fix at 22:40:00 to cancellation at 22:48:20, which is 500 seconds against the 480-second AIRPORT minimum - a surplus of 20 seconds, and the clock is run from the first in-geofence fix, not from the 'arrived' event, exactly as limb (c) requires. (d) The trip shows no boarding event and was terminated by the driver at 22:48:20, twenty seconds after the required dwell elapsed, on cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises.

No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the charge, and I answer each route the advocates raised. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) does not engage: it governs only a driver stationary outside the arrival radius but within 400 m, whereas here the driver was 24.0 m from the pin, inside the radius. POL-NS-04 (rider contact unanswered) fails at limb (b): the rider wrote 'I am walking over now' at 22:41:40 and the driver replied 'Okay, I will remain at Door 5' at 22:41:58, eighteen seconds later, inside the 120-second window, so the clause does not apply whatever the reply said. Limb (c) also fails affirmatively on the rider's own track - 519.47 m from the pin on its 24 fixes, with 0 qualifying fixes inside the 200 m AIRPORT rider-presence radius - but limb (b) alone closes this route. POL-NS-05 (false arrival marker) does not engage: matched to the 22:40:20 event the driver sat 24.0 m from the pin at 0.0 km/h, far inside the 300 m distance threshold and below the 15 km/h motion threshold, so no waiting clock is recomputed. POL-NS-06 (waiting-period shortfall) does not engage: the 500-second run against the 480-second minimum leaves a shortfall of -20.0 seconds, that is, no shortfall at all, and the trace shows a single in-geofence interval with no excursions, so the limb (i) accumulation question is never reached.

On the money: POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee itemised in the fare breakdown, which is SGD 4.80 (80 percent of SGD 6.00), the residual SGD 1.20 being the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not bite - driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the four-termination limb, and 1 divided by completed_trips_30d 120 is 0.008, below the 0.08 rate limb, and the clause requires both - so compensation is not withheld. The SGD 6.00 charge itself reconciles with the fee schedule: the AIRPORT zone-class fee is SGD 6.00 and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee is SGD 6.00, and the resolution rule takes the greater, so there is no fare defect under POL-NS-08(d).

On weight and escalation: the deciding facts are carried by the GPS trace, trip record, fare breakdown and driver profile, all at admissibility weight 1.0 with no issue codes, so nothing that decides this case is discounted. The missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09102-01 (weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) is disclosed, but no surviving claim builds on it and the trace shows a single in-geofence interval, so it carries no deciding fact and does not cap confidence or trigger escalation. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: neither profile shows disputes_with_counterparty_90d (both 0), rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, the anti-farming check has not tripped, and confidence is above the 0.70 floor. The driver's counterparty statement corroborates his account of waiting at Door 5 and replying promptly, consistent with the trace and chat log. Because the ruling moves money to the driver, amount_sgd and driver_compensation_sgd both carry the same figure, SGD 4.80; the rider's charge stands as itemised. No clause in this category produces a referral on these facts.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
